test_cases.name: D1 audit: OWASP Top 10 coverage chi ~40% (chi static grep, khong co full vuln scan)
test_cases.description: Phase 2 D1 (DISCREPANCY-1 IMPL-REFUTED): P-QD3-owasp-top-ten SKILL.md mieu ta '10 OWASP categories' nhung Phase 2 xac nhan chi 4/10 categories co static patterns (SQL injection, XSS, hardcoded secrets, path traversal). 6/10 categories con lai can runtime analysis. IMP-QD3-001 (P1): mo rong static patterns hoac document coverage gap ro rang.

input.scenario: Project co potential SSRF vulnerability (OWASP A10 - Server Side Request Forgery): user-controlled URL duoc fetch ma KHONG validate. Profile=standard.
input.vulnerability: OWASP A10 SSRF: fetch(userInput) without URL whitelist validation

expected.current_behavior: NO signal (SSRF pattern not in current static grep set)
expected.expected_after_IMP_QD3_001: signal emitted OR probe documents 'SSRF: runtime-only, not statically detectable'

test_cases.validation: TRUOC IMP-QD3-001: SSRF (A10) khong duoc detect → false negative cho critical vuln class. SAU IMP-QD3-001: phai co SSRF pattern hoac explicit note trong lane-report 'A10 SSRF: not statically detectable'. Coverage gap documented. Fixture: fixtures/qd3-test/ Phase 3 accuracy-report.md SPEC_GAP runtime-only sections.

test_cases.name: CASCADE-QD3-002 audit: CDG double-fire — auth-flow probe emit CDG 2 lan
test_cases.description: Phase 4 CASCADE-QD3-002: P-QD3-auth-flow-security spawn AI agent cho analysis. Khi CDG-AGENT-DOWN, ca probe bash script VA SKILL.md CDG handler deu fire → CDG flag duoc ghi 2 lan vao signals.json → signal deduplication logic bi break. IMP-QD3-010 (P2): CDG handler phai co idempotent guard.

input.scenario: P-QD3-auth-flow-security duoc chay voi profile=standard. CDG condition: AI agent subprocess tra ve CDG-AGENT-DOWN. Probe co ca bash-level CDG emit (line 45) va SKILL.md-level CDG handler → double fire.

expected.current_behavior: CDG flag duoc append 2 lan vao signals.json → duplicate entries
expected.expected_after_IMP_QD3_010: CDG flag chi xuat hien 1 lan (idempotent dedup guard)

test_cases.validation: TRUOC IMP-QD3-010: signals.json co 2 CDG entries cung source → downstream aggregation bi sai. SAU IMP-QD3-010: CDG emit phai idempotent — check existing before append. IMP-QD3-010 linked to global IMP-024 CDG Governance (5-dim pattern).

test_cases.name: ADR-22 Rule 6 enforcement: cache NEVER cho security lane — khong co runtime check
test_cases.description: Phase 1 D (ADR-22): Security lane PHAI khong bao gio dung scan cache (false negatives tren cache hits = security miss). dim.json co cache_allowed=false nhung SKILL.md KHONG co runtime enforcement guard. IMP-QD3-003 (P1): them PRE-GATE assertion 'ASSERT cache_calls == 0'.

input.scenario: Session dir co .scan-cache/ tu previous run voi stale results. QD3 lane duoc spawn. SKILL.md khong co explicit check ASSERT(cache_calls==0) nen co the tinh nang cache bi leak tu skill invocation.

expected.current_behavior: No runtime enforcement — cache might be used if caller passes --use-cache flag
expected.expected_after_IMP_QD3_003: PRE-GATE assertion: ASSERT(cache_calls == 0 for all QD3 probes), fail if violated

test_cases.validation: SAU IMP-QD3-003: SKILL.md PRE-GATE phai co assert cache_allowed=false + verify no --use-cache in probe invocations. Neu cache leak detected → STOP voi error 'E-QD3-cache-violation'. TC-QD3-004 da test ADR-22 result; TC-audit-QD3-007 test enforcement mechanism.
test_cases.audit_ref: 04-qd3-security-audit.md Phase 1 ADR-22 Rule 6 + TC-QD3-004 existing test + IMP-QD3-003
